Yes, that archive/finished separation is exactly what I meant. Finished links remain part of my normal collection; archived links are deliberately hidden but recoverable; deletion is permanent and requires confirmation.

Clearing the selection after an action and when changing to Archived feels safest. “Select all in this view” should mean every bookmark matching the current search, label, and All/To read/Finished or Archived view, including results not currently visible.

One small correction: when adding or removing labels in bulk, please suggest my existing labels there too. For removal, it would be especially helpful to show labels that occur on the selected bookmarks so I don’t have to remember and type them exactly.
